description:
I’m Rajratn, an Engineering Admission and Career Counsellor dedicated to helping students make clear, confident decisions after 12th.
I guide students through college and branch selection across Maharashtra based on their interests, strengths, and realistic outcomes.
My work includes detailed cutoff analysis, CAP round strategy, and accurate option filling to avoid common admission mistakes.
I believe in honest guidance, simple explanations, and putting the student’s long-term growth first.
My goal is to make the admission process less confusing and more transparent for students and parents alike.
